node: Data-center power distribution, low-voltage electrical equipment, cooling, and rack-level infrastructure components
summary: Layer 1B expands the node beyond obvious AI chip and hyperscaler names. Vertiv is kept as a reference leader for power/cooling/rack infrastructure. The underfollowed lane highlights Modine, Powell Industries, and nVent as US-listed suppliers whose exposure sits in cooling systems, switchgear/electrical distribution, rack PDUs, coolant distribution units, manifolds, enclosures, and connection infrastructure. These are second-order beneficiaries of AI rack density and power-constrained data-center buildouts, but later layers must verify revenue mix, backlog durability, customer concentration, capacity constraints, and whether recent re-ratings have already priced in the bottleneck.
